frontmatter.title: Blissful Blinds UK - Client Business E-Commerce Site

content:
**Blissful Blinds UK** is a full-featured commercial website engineered for a UK-based business client, complete with custom quote forms, automated business email, customer reviews, chatbot integration, and technical SEO optimizations.

### Tech Stack & Technologies

- **Frontend & Web:** React.js, JavaScript, CSS3
- **Backend Services:** Node.js, Nodemailer (Hostinger Email)
- **Deployment & SEO:** Vercel Hosting, Performance & On-Page SEO Optimization

### Key Features

- **Automated Quotation System:** Custom quotation forms that process customer measurements and send structured lead emails directly to the sales team.
- **Interactive Chatbot & Reviews:** Built-in customer review module and chatbot widget to enhance conversion rates.
- **SEO & Performance Optimization:** Optimized for fast page load speed, mobile responsiveness, and high Google search visibility.

frontmatter.title: GiftyGo - AI Gift Recommendation & Discovery Engine

content:
**GiftyGo** is an AI recommendation platform that generates tailored gift suggestions based on recipient personality traits, occasion, budget, and intelligent ranking models.

### Tech Stack & Technologies

- **Frontend:** React.js, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express.js API
- **AI Integration:** Google Gemini API
- **Database:** MongoDB

### Key Features

- **Personalized Recommendations:** Uses Gemini LLM to interpret recipient preferences and suggest thoughtful, creative gift items.
- **Budget & Occasion Filter:** Dynamically ranks gift ideas according to user price limits and occasion categories (birthdays, anniversaries, holidays).
- **Interactive Discovery UI:** Clean, modern user interface for quick product discovery and save-for-later wishlists.

frontmatter.title: JARVIS Student AI - AI Study Productivity Companion

content:
**JARVIS Student AI** is an intelligent study-productivity mobile application designed to streamline academic workflows for students through smart scheduling, AI note summarization, assignment tracking, and automated reminders.

### Tech Stack & Technologies

- **Frontend & Mobile:** React Native
- **AI Integration:** Google Gemini API
- **Cloud Infrastructure:** Firebase Firestore & Auth

### Key Features

- **Smart Academic Planner:** Generates customized study schedules based on assignment due dates and upcoming exam schedules.
- **AI Notes Assistant:** Summarizes lecture notes, textbook excerpts, and complex concepts instantly using Google Gemini LLM.
- **Assignment Tracker & Reminders:** Keeps students organized with real-time push notifications and cloud synchronization across devices.

frontmatter.title: MediReport AI - Intelligent Medical Lab Report Analyzer

content:
**MediReport AI** is an AI-powered medical lab-report analyzer that extracts key physiological and biological metrics from scanned lab reports using OCR pipelines and translates them into plain-language clinical explanations using Large Language Models (LLMs).

### Tech Stack & Technologies

- **Frontend & Mobile:** React Native
- **Backend Services:** FastAPI (Python)
- **AI & OCR Pipelines:** Google Gemini API, PaddleOCR
- **Cloud & Auth:** Firebase Authentication & Cloud Storage

### Key Features

- **Automated Document OCR:** Scans complex medical lab report documents and extracts tabular diagnostic metrics with high precision.
- **LLM Diagnostic Summaries:** Leverages Google Gemini to interpret medical terminology and output easy-to-understand health summaries for patients.
- **Secure Authentication & Storage:** Built-in user authentication with cloud synchronization for historical lab report tracking.

frontmatter.title: MenuCloud - Digital Restaurant Menu & Ordering Platform

content:
**MenuCloud** is a comprehensive cloud restaurant-menu platform enabling touchless QR-code ordering, real-time menu management, and an administration analytics dashboard for restaurant owners.

### Tech Stack & Technologies

- **Frontend:** React.js, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express.js REST API
- **Database:** MongoDB

### Key Features

- **QR-Code Mobile Ordering:** Dine-in customers can instantly scan QR codes on tables to browse interactive digital menus and place orders.
- **Admin Dashboard:** Restaurant managers can update prices, mark items in/out of stock, and track order metrics in real time.
- **Responsive Architecture:** Blazing fast user experience optimized across mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports.

frontmatter.title: Organization Finance Management System (Final Year Project)

content:
**Organization Finance Management System** is an enterprise-grade financial management platform developed as a Final Year Project to handle organizational income, expenses, analytics dashboards, and auditing reports.

### Tech Stack & Technologies

- **Frontend:** React.js, Bootstrap
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express.js REST API
- **Database:** MongoDB
- **Security:** JWT Authentication & Role-Based Access Control

### Key Features

- **Income & Expense Tracking:** Categorizes financial transactions with itemized logging and budget allocation.
- **Analytics & Reporting:** Generates visual financial charts, revenue vs. expense comparisons, and exportable PDF audit reports.
- **Role-Based Access Control:** Secure user permission levels for accountants, managers, and administrative executives.
